content: Tawakalubino Komokomo Anagilamelelame Komo
Ba꞉bene Ya꞉suti gala na꞉kagoiya꞉, “Komo tawakalubino kuba ododili komoma꞉ la꞉le ibi kubapima꞉ tiyolo akaka꞉lama꞉la꞉, ba꞉bene Godote la꞉ kubapima꞉ a꞉kaka꞉lama꞉mena꞉ta,

mabu la꞉le tawakalubino komo keba ka꞉na danagilamelelamema, Godote ba꞉ ba꞉ba ka꞉na la꞉eno komo kanagilamelelamema꞉na꞉ta, ba꞉gala la꞉ komopa꞉tamo keba ka꞉na dododilinakoma, ba꞉ba ka꞉na Godote la꞉tamo atumu ba꞉ka-ododilinakomene.
Keka꞉ mabu ama꞉le ekawino baidilo puhulu deha꞉poto umilo huiyatiya amia꞉no baidilo ditana ba꞉be ko keha tete kuminaha꞉?

Ba꞉gala bada mabuma꞉ amia꞉no ekawitamo ba꞉ma ka꞉na da꞉goita, ‘Wadiyala amia꞉no baidilo ditana ba꞉be puhulu deha꞉poto nale kolawemema꞉nemata,’ huiyatiya amia꞉no baidilo ditana ba꞉be ko keha tete ama꞉ kalawenaha꞉?

A꞉iye! Ama꞉ ma꞉lapila netewa lumagilata! Wadiyala ama꞉ dopamo amia꞉no baidilo ditana ba꞉be keha lawete, ama꞉le galane hidamo gahimiti amia꞉no ekawino baidilo ditana ba꞉be puhulu deha꞉poto ba꞉bo kolawemema꞉na꞉ta.

“Ba꞉gala ba꞉moe ba꞉ eta komola, la꞉le Godokono talona ilina gahagahatamo akikalama꞉la꞉. La꞉ ba꞉ba ka꞉na dewagelema, diyala, iba꞉te la꞉tamo ohobila꞉te la꞉ kubanomamo da꞉ aloholetamena꞉, ba꞉gala la꞉eno hidohido mani goegoa꞉tamo akikalama꞉la꞉, iba꞉te ba꞉bi ilina natamo mikimoelete dito miya꞉paledemena꞉.”
Modoboha꞉ Tetelo Godoko Toemeho Komo

Ba꞉bene Ya꞉suti gala na꞉kagoiya꞉, “La꞉ Godoko na꞉toemehala꞉, ebete la꞉tamo kikalamema꞉na꞉ta. Iyo, la꞉ ebeno hido komo nohowada꞉la꞉, la꞉le kumima꞉nemata, ba꞉gala gigiho nanakama꞉la꞉, ebete la꞉tamo ka꞉hiya꞉midama꞉ne.

Numa꞉la꞉, puya꞉te Godoko da꞉toemehonaka, iba꞉te ebegodone kolawema꞉na꞉, ba꞉gala puya꞉te ebeno hido komo dohowadinaka iba꞉te kumima꞉na꞉, ba꞉gala puya꞉te gigiho danakaminaka ebete iba꞉tamo ka꞉hiya꞉midama꞉ne.
La꞉ ipuwalo kebe dubu ebeno guduti ebe baa꞉ma꞉ da꞉toemehomene, huiyatiya ebetamo nakola ba꞉kikamemene?
Ba꞉gala amia꞉no guduti ama꞉ dahama꞉ da꞉toemehomena꞉, ama꞉ huiyatiya ebetamo bu kalu ba꞉kikameomena꞉?

Numa꞉la꞉, la꞉ hidohido tawakalubiha꞉ huiyatiya la꞉ iya꞉tawahala la꞉eno guguda꞉tamo hidohido baa꞉ ikalamema꞉, ba꞉bema꞉ la꞉eno Hunu Haboeno Nabiwiti atumu iya꞉tawanomola hidohido komo tawakaluba꞉tamo ikalamema꞉, puya꞉te ebe da꞉toemehonaka iba꞉tamo kikalamema꞉ne.

“Ba꞉bema꞉ tawakaluba꞉te la꞉tamo bada komo ododima꞉ la꞉le ubi dihatenakoma, la꞉ komopa꞉tamo ba꞉ ba꞉ba ka꞉na nododinakuya꞉la꞉, mabu Godote ebeno Tutumu Tabo Moseseko ipuwado tawakaluba꞉tamo dikalamiya꞉ ba꞉gala ebeno ukui hawakalimipa꞉te ebeno Bukamo da꞉miya꞉tiya꞉, ba꞉bi koko taboeno ipuwa kapiya ba꞉ ba꞉ma ka꞉nala, la꞉ komopa꞉tamo malemale komo na꞉hawakaliminakuya꞉la꞉.”
Tutuwa Gigihoeno Komo

Ba꞉bene Ya꞉suti gala na꞉kagoiya꞉, “La꞉ tutuwa gigihodo na꞉pa꞉la꞉hala꞉, mabu Koe Habamo da꞉na꞉pa꞉la꞉hanaka ba꞉be gigiho konomola, gabo kodakodaha꞉. Tawakalubi hiliyonomate ba꞉bana na꞉pa꞉la꞉hate ba꞉be gabodo tolamena.
Huiyatiya Godokono Ka꞉ka꞉ Habamo da꞉na꞉pa꞉la꞉hanaka ba꞉be gigiho tutuwanomola, gabo kodakodala. Tawakalubi kapiyakapiyate ba꞉be gigiho numiti ba꞉bana tolamena.”
Keha Ba꞉gala Ebeno Gao

Ba꞉bene Ya꞉suti gala na꞉kagoiya꞉, “La꞉le Godokono mahilamo ha꞉da tabo olamagimipi hidamo nulama꞉la꞉. Iba꞉te gelebadihole sipi-goegoeno tama pupuliti la꞉tamo ba꞉bo pelamenaka, huiyatiya ibino tepo ipuwalo ibi helohelo gahagaha keba ka꞉nala꞉ka꞉ ba꞉ba ka꞉nala.
La꞉ ibino ododili komokomo hidamo nulamelelamiya꞉la꞉. Lumagiti hidohido gala꞉ipi gao olagoeno kehalo a꞉kanulama꞉mene, ba꞉gala ebete olagoeno kehamo tote anahu kehoeno gao a꞉kanetapihamene.
Numa꞉la꞉, hidohido kehalo hidohido gaote konolohoma꞉na꞉, ba꞉gala kuba kehalo ba꞉ kuba gaote konolohoma꞉na꞉.
Iyo, hido kehalo kuba gaote a꞉kanolohamena꞉, ba꞉gala kuba kehalo hidohido gaote a꞉kanolohamena꞉,
ba꞉bema꞉ hibila, hidohido gao nolohoha꞉ keha tawakaluba꞉te luhuti koa꞉mo kiya꞉hekema꞉na꞉.
Ba꞉bema꞉ la꞉ ha꞉da tabo olamagimipino ododili komokomo ba ulame la꞉le ibino noloho komamo ibino hibi komo ba꞉bo kiya꞉tawahama꞉nemata.

“Numa꞉la꞉, puya꞉te na Kodawama꞉ dito da꞉ka꞉naminaka huiyatiya hibi komo puliyala, ba꞉bi tawakaluba꞉te Godokono Hunu Habamo a꞉kana꞉pa꞉la꞉hamena꞉. Huiyatiya puya꞉te naeno Nabiwino ubi komamo da꞉papamila꞉halena, ibi kapiyate ebeno Hunu Habamo kona꞉pa꞉la꞉hama꞉na꞉.

Ba꞉bema꞉ Godokono Ko Hegelalo komopa꞉te natamo ba꞉ma ka꞉na koga꞉lama꞉na꞉, ‘Kodawa, Kodawa! Ale amia꞉no mahilamo Godokono tabo olamagiminakuima꞉, ba꞉gala amia꞉no mahilamo kuba gobogobo oelamenakuima꞉, ba꞉gala atumu ale komo hanohano komo ododilinakuima꞉.’
Huiyatiya nale iba꞉tamo kogoema꞉nemo, ‘Na iya꞉tawaha꞉ la꞉eno komo. La꞉ kuba ododilipilata, nagodone na꞉tolama꞉la꞉!’”
Genama Netewa Etemotepino Komo

Ba꞉bene Ya꞉suti gala na꞉kagoiya꞉, “Kebe lumagiti naeno tabo ulihote ba꞉bi komokomo dododilimini, ebe hido mulu ukui lumagila. Ebete ebeno genama kodakoda haka hunamo detiya꞉, ba꞉be dubu keba ka꞉nala꞉ka꞉ ba꞉ba ka꞉nala.
Ba꞉ba tetelo wegolate duya꞉ beyate ba꞉bo odoluya꞉, ba꞉bene konomo gogote pete genama da꞉pemida꞉miya꞉ genamate kakaguya꞉ha꞉ mabu ebete hido hakamo etiya꞉.
Huiyatiya kebe lumagiti naeno tabo ulihote ododilihino, ebe ba꞉ daedae ukui lumagila. Ebete ebeno genama kulili hakamo detiya꞉ ba꞉be dubu huiyala.
Ba꞉ba tetelo wegolate duya꞉ beyate ba꞉bo odoluya꞉, ba꞉bene konomo gogote pete genama da꞉pemida꞉miya꞉ genamate kagate kubanomoma꞉ ba꞉bo ediya꞉. O olalati bada konomola꞉ka꞉!”
Tabo Ulihopa꞉te Ya꞉suku Mabuma꞉ Da꞉hanohanohuya꞉
Ba꞉bene Ya꞉suti ba꞉moi komokomo olamagi da꞉wibuya꞉ ebeno tabo ulihopi hiliyonomate na꞉hanohanohutiya꞉,
mabu ebete Godokono heloamo iya꞉tulamitiya꞉, huiyatiya ebe ibino Godokono Tutumu iya꞉tulamepi huiyaha꞉.
